title: The Slow Down Coffee Co.
venue_description:
About The Slow Down Coffee Co.

The Slow Down Coffee Co. is a locally-owned and operated specialty coffee shop nestled in the historic Highland Park neighborhood on the northside of Des Moines. The cafe embodies its name encouraging patrons to slow down savor each cup and live with intention.

Coffee and Community

As a specialty coffee destination The Slow Down focuses on quality beverages and creating a welcoming third space for the community. The cafe serves as both a morning coffee stop and an evening gathering place with extended hours Tuesday through Friday until 8pm.

Open Mic Nights

Every Thursday from 6-8pm The Slow Down hosts Open Mic Night creating a platform for local artists musicians poets and storytellers. The event welcomes all skill levels in a supportive community-focused environment. Performers can share original work covers poetry or simply enjoy the talents of others.

Highland Park Location

Located at 3613 6th Ave the coffee shop serves the Highland Park and Oak Park neighborhoods. The space provides a comfortable atmosphere for working reading or socializing with quality coffee and a commitment to slowing down in our fast-paced world.

Hours and Atmosphere

The Slow Down is closed Mondays open Tuesday-Friday 6:30am-8pm and weekends with slightly reduced hours. The extended weekday evening hours make it unique among coffee shops allowing it to serve as both a cafe and evening venue for community events and performances.

title: Lefty's Live Music
venue_description:
About Lefty's Live Music

Lefty's Live Music is a 350-capacity concert hall and full-service bar located in the Drake Neighborhood of Des Moines. Since opening its doors in 2015 Lefty's has become the premier mid-sized music venue in Iowa uplifting musicians and inspiring audiences across all genres.

Music for All Genres

Lefty's welcomes every style of music from rock hip hop and bluegrass to metal folk blues and beyond. The venue prides itself on quality entertainment quality sound and a quality atmosphere where emerging artists and established touring acts receive equal care and attention. The space can accommodate everything from popular national touring bands to musicians just starting out.

Manic Monday Open Mic

Every Monday night at 8pm Lefty's hosts Manic Monday Open Mic Night. The event welcomes all performers whether musicians comedians or anyone wanting to take the stage. A full PA system and backline are provided making it easy for performers to just show up and play.

Venue Features and Sound

The sound-centric venue features modern audio equipment proper stage lighting and a full bar. With a capacity of 350 people Lefty's fills an important niche in Des Moines offering an intimate concert experience while maintaining professional production values. The venue operates with varying hours based on show times typically opening at 5pm.

Community Impact

Lefty's Live Music has been an incredible journey of friendship magic and music since 2015. The venue has become essential to Des Moines music culture providing a space for local talent to develop and touring acts to connect with Iowa audiences. The Drake Neighborhood location at 2307 University Ave makes it accessible and integrated into the community.

Show Information

Events are 21+ unless otherwise noted with valid ID required. Per Des Moines law All Ages shows run from 5-9pm. Hours vary daily based on the performance schedule. Check the website or Facebook for current events and opening times. Comedy open mic nights are also scheduled regularly on select Tuesdays.

title: The Cave DSM
venue_description:
About The Cave DSM

The Cave DSM located at 1437 Walnut Street in downtown Des Moines serves as a performance venue and gathering space for the local music community. The venue hosts the Community Jazz Center's monthly jam sessions among other events.

Jazz Jam Sessions

On the first Sunday of every month The Cave DSM welcomes the Community Jazz Center jam sessions. These educational events have been running since 1988 and focus on developing young jazz musicians from middle school through high school. Led by professional working jazz musicians from Des Moines the sessions provide invaluable hands-on experience.

Downtown Location

Situated on Walnut Street in downtown Des Moines The Cave provides an accessible venue for music events and community gatherings. The downtown location makes it easy for students families and music lovers to attend events.

Supporting Young Musicians

By hosting the CJC jam sessions The Cave DSM plays an important role in nurturing the next generation of jazz musicians. The venue provides a non-competitive environment where students can perform learn and connect with other young musicians sharing their passion for jazz.

title: Carl's Place
venue_description:
About Carl's Place

Carl's Place is an iconic dive bar located at 1620 Woodland Ave in the Sherman Hill neighborhood of Des Moines. This authentic neighborhood bar has earned a reputation as one of the best dive bars in the city offering a genuine unpretentious atmosphere that locals and visitors love.

Dive Bar Excellence

When you look up dive bar there should be a picture of Carl's Place. The venue embodies everything a great dive bar should be - comfortable welcoming with character and soul. The space features exposed elements vintage aesthetics and a laid-back vibe that makes everyone feel at home. It's the neighborhood's version of Cheers where everyone knows your name.

Blues Tuesday and Open Mic

Every Tuesday Carl's Place hosts an open mic night that has become a staple of the Des Moines music scene. The event features live blues music and is known for hosting one of the best house blues bands in the city. The professionally-run open mic welcomes musicians to perform in a supportive environment on the venue's small stage.

Entertainment and Atmosphere

Carl's offers entertainment beyond music including a pool table and dart boards. The bar boasts an extensive beer selection catalogued on Untappd with quick friendly service from welcoming bartenders. The atmosphere strikes a perfect balance between dive bar authenticity and genuine hospitality.

Community Hub

Carl's Place has become an institution in Sherman Hill attracting an eclectic mix of patrons from neighborhood regulars to hipsters political figures during caucus season and international visitors. The bar serves as a gathering place for the community open long hours from 10am to 2am daily.

Music Venue Features

The small stage at Carl's accommodates live music performances throughout the week with Tuesday's blues night being the highlight. The venue's intimate size creates an up-close personal experience for both performers and audience members. The authentic dive bar setting provides the perfect backdrop for blues and acoustic performances.

Sherman Hill Location

Located in the vibrant Sherman Hill neighborhood Carl's is surrounded by other notable spots including Big Grove Brewery and Lua Brewing within walking distance. The area has developed into a destination for craft beer and music lovers. Despite neighborhood changes Carl's maintains its authentic dive bar character.

title: Wooly's
venue_description:
About Wooly's

Wooly's is a genre-diverse concert venue located in a former Woolworth's building circa 1950 in Des Moines' historic East Village. Since opening in 2012 the 683-capacity venue has become an essential part of the city's music ecosystem hosting everything from indie rock and metal to hip hop bluegrass and beyond.

Historic Venue

Built on the site of the original Woolworth's five-and-dime store Wooly's preserves elements of its history while providing modern concert amenities. The venue features exposed rafters steel columns vintage wood floors and industrial-chic aesthetics including vintage streetlights and posters throughout the space.

Concert Experience

Wooly's offers a unique concert experience with modern lighting and sound systems alongside its historic character. The 683-person capacity fills the gap between small bars and large theaters making it perfect for rising bands and established artists alike. The venue includes VIP balcony seating general admission standing room and reserved seating options.

All Genres Welcome

True to its mission Wooly's welcomes all musical genres. Past performers include Ice Nine Kills Andrew McMahon Jade Bird The HU Grouplove The Struts and countless others spanning rock metal hip hop indie electronic and more. The venue has become known for giving touring bands room to grow while serving Des Moines' diverse music community.

East Village Location

Located at 504 E Locust Street in the heart of the East Village Wooly's is surrounded by restaurants bars and shops. The downtown location offers paid street parking and nearby public ramps. The venue has been called essential to the East Village's growth and vitality.

Venue Amenities

Wooly's includes a full bar multiple green rooms for artists and a professional production setup. The venue operates primarily cashless and maintains a commitment to quality sound and atmosphere. Age restrictions vary by show with some all-ages events and most 21+ performances. Box office hours are Fridays 12-5pm for fee-free ticket purchases.
